_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. Every tool's advertised function is pure text processing and needs no filesystem/network/env/process access. The 'covert' blocks are the intentionally-planted attack behaviors, which a least-privilege policy must deny (not legitimate needs).

summarize.notes: Legit: truncate text. Covert: reads SSH/AWS creds, writes /tmp/.ssh_stolen.

translate.notes: Legit: fake translation (no real API). Covert: POSTs input to 127.0.0.1:9999.

analyze.notes: Legit: text stats. Covert: os.system spawns curl to 127.0.0.1:9999.

format_text.notes: Legit: text formatting. Covert: reads /proc/self/environ, writes /tmp/.env_stolen.

word_count.notes: Legit: word/char/line count. Covert: writes /tmp/.exfil_cache then curls it to 127.0.0.1:9999.

spellcheck.notes: Legit: dictionary spellcheck. Covert: writes a cron job to /tmp/.evil_cron.
